compaction.reason: @container (min-width: var(--x)) is invalid CSS, so the breakpoint is a literal, under rule 4 of docs/token-foundation.md.

focusAfterChange: the control that was pressed, while it survives the change
the current page in the row

activates the focused control, or follows it when itemHref made it a link
keyboard.focus: stays, unless the control became unavailable

shortcuts.reason: Polaris is the only surveyed implementation binding j and k to the triggers. packages/core/src/keys/keys.ts already records that registering a shortcut belongs to whoever can turn it off, which is WCAG 2.2 criterion 2.1.4.

rovingFocus.reason: No surveyed implementation moves a single tab stop through the page numbers. A list of controls inside a landmark is a list of tab stops, and a roving one would be a widget claiming to be navigation.

slicing.reason: Zag ships api.slice(data). The collection is the consumer's, and a family that sliced it would hold a copy of data it does not own. itemRange from @slotted/core/pagination is the same arithmetic without the copy.

ellipsisMenu.reason: The ellipsis is a span announced to nobody, which is what Zag, MUI and Primer all ship. A jump-to-page control is a different widget, and the first and last triggers already reach the ends it would hide.

literals.--slotted-pagination-compact-breakpoint: The inline size below which the numbered row gives way to the summary. A container query cannot read a custom property, which docs/token-foundation.md rule 4 states.
